# Core (2) FULL_TOPIC_PAIR integration questions

These two questions are repository-owned original fixtures. They exist only to test the Core (1) question-custody → Core (2) paired-publication pipeline. They are **not** past-paper questions and must not be cited as evidence of any external exam's question frequency or style.

## Q1

A 2 kg block on a frictionless horizontal surface has a 6 N horizontal force to the right. What is its acceleration?

Answer key: 3 m/s^2 to the right.

## Q2

Two horizontal forces, 10 N right and 4 N left, act on a 2 kg object. Determine the acceleration and direction.

Answer key: 3 m/s^2 to the right.
